title: Three Seasons and One Short Beam
subtitle: 体育运动 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 体育运动（人与社会·文学、艺术与体育·体育与运动）
meta: 主题语境：体育运动（人与社会·文学、艺术与体育·体育与运动）　|　核心词汇：gymnastics　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 gymnastics 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 the trainer ① taught the gymnastics that no pupil in the hall would have described, and she said the teaching was the whole of the season. The ② gymnastics, meaning the exercises themselves and not the beam, ran three seasons and stayed undescribed in the book; gymnastics, she said, is the only thing in a hall that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ kind of gymnastics in that hall had the same short beam beside it, and the ④ gymnastics at the far mat, meaning the set they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Gymnastics, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the trainer said the describing is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the gymnastics was the whole of the matter, meaning the discipline and not the exercises. The ⑥ gymnastics, meaning the discipline and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; gymnastics, he said, is either something you teach or the only word that means both an exercise and a discipline. He said the discipline is the part they remember.

By 1988 the ⑦ gymnastics had become a line in a card, and the card had become an argument about the short beam. The ⑧ gymnastics of the whole thing, the trainer wrote in November, was one hall and three seasons of describing; gymnastics, she said, is either the set at the far mat or the reason you learned to describe. She said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ gymnastics I remember is the set described in the card, which closed in 1990 and is still described as the quietest in the hall. ⑩ Gymnastics, my mother said in 1992, is the only exercise that improves by being described; all gymnastics, she said, is a discipline that has agreed to look like an exercise. She said the discipline was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 体操；体操训练（指大厅里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 体操；体操训练（指那些动作本身，与平衡木相对）
C. 固定搭配：teach the gymnastics 教体操
D. n. 体操（指留给孩子们学着练的那一套）
E. n. 体操（抽象总称，指一处大厅的体操之事）
F. n. 体操（指卡片里写到、被记下的那一套）
G. n. 基本功；技巧（指一件事里人人都练却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 功底（抽象总称，指人人都练却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: taught the gymnastics that no pupil in the hall would have described
The gymnastics, meaning the exercises themselves and not the beam
Every kind of gymnastics in that hall
the gymnastics at the far mat
the gymnastics was the whole of the matter
the gymnastics had become a line in a card
The gymnastics of the whole thing

answers.why: teach the gymnastics 意为“教体操”，1983 年那位教练教了大厅里没有一位学生肯描述的体操。
gymnastics 意为“体操、体操训练”，指那些动作本身而不是平衡木，它经过了三个赛季而在簿子上没有被描述。
gymnastics 意为“体操、体操训练”，指大厅里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一条矮矮的平衡木。
gymnastics 意为“体操”，指最远那块垫子旁留给孩子们学着练的那一套，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
gymnastics 意为“基本功、技巧”，指一件事里人人都练却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份功底就是那件事的全部。
gymnastics 意为“功底”，指人人都练却无人提起的那样东西而不是那套体操，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
gymnastics 意为“体操”，指卡片里写到、被记下的那一套，到 1988 年这一套成了卡片上的一行。
gymnastics 意为“体操”，教练十一月写道，整件事的体操之事是一处大厅和三个赛季的描述。
gymnastics 意为“体操”，我记得的是卡片里描述过的那一套，1990 年练完了，至今仍被说成大厅里最安静的一套。
gymnastics 为抽象总称，母亲 1992 年说，体操是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的训练。
